question: Can the Pylos pilot acquire source-linked linguistic analyses without fabricating a same-snapshot alignment?
review_questions: Are the source IDs and literal context fields faithfully projected, with versions kept separate?
Can the source editor supply an annotated bounded package with item.id and phys_word.id from the same version, or identify a documented public route?
Does any proposed alignment preserve alternative analyses, missing/unannotated units, source provenance and the existing blind-field firewall?
